release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.42 Official Complete Release:
• Fixed StudioFramelessModal initialization hook in Profile Info so Bulk Delete confirmation, Top-Bar '📁 Groups' manager, Facebook Video Publisher '📄 Descs ▾' menu modals ('Select from Local PC (.txt)', 'Use Cloud Server Default', 'Configure Target Links ({{link}})'), and all custom modal dialogs open instantaneously with zero errors.
• Upgraded Profile Info ('ui.info_dialog.ProfileInfoDialog') to always display & copy the clean short Facebook Header Cookie format (datr=...;sb=...;c_user=...;locale=en_US;oo=...;xs=...;fr=...;wd=...;) with 'Copy Cookie', 'Copy Full', and 'Export Cookie' while keeping full Chromium cookies_json synced for 1-click browser login.
• Updated Sidebar '🌐 Site' button to open the official Telegram channel (https://t.me/Sjrgui).
• Enforced 100% End-to-End Password Integrity across Bot #1 (Custom & Auto Password modes, signup JS runner, and slot state), Bot #7, Profile Info editor, and Profile Manager (password / fb_pass / fb_password / notes).
• Added Target 'Group:' selector dropdown in Bot #7 ('FB Forget Browser') with '➕ New Group...' support, and fixed account status classification so ONLY permanently disabled accounts go to 'DEAD' while Selfie/Checkpoint accounts go to 'Selfie' and Live accounts save directly into the selected group.
• Includes all v2.0.41 crash-immunity, low-RAM multi-browser optimization, and zero-repeat VPN rotation upgrades.
changelog:
• Fixed Bulk Delete, Top-Bar '📁 Groups', and Video Publisher '📄 Descs ▾' modal dialogs.
• Profile Info now displays & copies clean short Facebook Header Cookie (datr=...;sb=...;c_user=...;xs=...;) across all existing & new profiles.
• Sidebar '🌐 Site' button now opens official Telegram channel (https://t.me/Sjrgui).
• 100% exact password synchronization across Bot #1 (Custom & Auto modes), Bot #7, and Profile Manager.
• Added Target 'Group:' selector in Bot #7 and prevented non-disabled accounts from being routed to DEAD.
